behaviorChanges: standing autonomy directive rendered capability-aware and emitted first by goal-kickoff-prompt/lane-start/context-bootstrap + new `autonomy-directive` verb; new `autonomy.standingDirective` knob (absent = on); canonical rules gain Unattended Operation; no guard, gate, or review mechanics changed

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Repinning below this release removes the `autonomy-directive` verb and the first-output directive emission; nothing on disk migrates. A lane that explicitly stored an `autonomy` key and repins a pre-feature runtime will hit the adapter schema's additionalProperties:false rejection -- rollback is to remove the `autonomy` key and regenerate the lane adapter first, then repin.
